notes.title: Ver 1.0.4 Updated
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Ver 1.0.4 has been updated.
This patch includes some improvements about the feedback and some bug fixes.
Please refer to the following for the details.

[b]<Balance Tweaks>[/b]
- The pattern difficulty of boss "Dragon Scale Armor" and "Resurrected Armor" has been decreased.
: Invincibility activation cooldown time has been extended.
: Use of invincibility has been limited to 2 times.

- The number of monsters that Boss "Resurrected Armor" spawns has been reduced to 1.

[b]<Enhancements>[/b]
- Revisions have been made to let the player play on even after the save files have been damaged.
- The readability of certain texts has been enhanced. (For Steam Deck)
- The lighting quality of certain maps has been improved.
- Translation quality has been enhanced.

[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
- Issues regarding the loss of focus of the equip UI every once in a while have been fixed.
- Issues regarding the use of midair double dash without the core skill in certain circumstances have been fixed.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.3 Updated
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Ver 1.0.3 has been updated.
Please refer to the following for the details.

<Balance Adjustments>
- Great Swords' Parry Chasing Attacks have gotten faster.
- Enemies that has been hit by Parry Chasing Attacks have been adjusted to be pushed just a little bit.

<Quality Enhancements>
- Optimization of low spec PCs has been generally completed.
- Localization of screenshots of Traces has been accomplished.
- Translation quality has been enhanced.

<Bug fixes>
- An issue where the character gets stuck in a wall in certain situations has been managed.
- An issue where the focus of the portal UI isn't right in certain situations has been managed.
- An issue where the direction of The Abyss Demon gets misaligned in certain situations has been managed.
- An issue where the protective occults are used duplicately has been managed.
